H2.cost_note: Setup-plus-edge units are hypothetical. Feature tokens are recorded separately; no human-time or dollar costs are inferred.

semantic_control.note: A false assertion wins under false supplied priorities.

H5.work_boundary: Fact reevaluations and dependency-index touches only; no total CPU, latency, disk I/O, concurrency or durability claim.

bootstrap.note: Paired fixed-fit source-group intervals; descriptive, non-simultaneous, repeated evaluation data.

evidence: H1 reused saved predictions; H2 simulated review; H3-H5 controlled algorithms. No independent semantic test.

input_verification.analysis_comparison: exact counts/labels/structure; float atol 1e-14, rtol 1e-12 for cross-platform roundoff
input_verification.limitation: Request/response journals are local provenance, not provider-signed attestations; failed responses remain failures.
input_verification.network_disabled_replay: identical predictions and execution after CRLF/LF normalization
